verdict.rationale: Sill's docs say every connection is encrypted and that only paired devices can connect (sill-docs-7). They also say there is no account or server, so screen and keystrokes travel only between your own devices, which implies device-to-device encryption (sill-docs-13). However, this is exactly the bare assertion the story rejects: no protocol, cipher suite, key exchange or pairing cryptography is documented anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented encryption protocol/cipher and key-exchange details, description of how pairing establishes trust, independent or hands-on verification of the encryption.
